opportunities.title: Milwaukee Commercial Revitalization Grants
opportunities.audience: Eligible city commercial-corridor businesses and property owners
opportunities.summary: City commercial signage (up to $2,500), façade (up to $5,000), storefront activation (up to $25,000) and Retail Investment Fund programs, each with separate conditions.
opportunities.qualifier: Reimbursable, matching funds/eligible costs and preapproval may apply; next posted 2026 deadlines Nov 5 and Dec 3. Verify funds and actual deadlines directly before suggesting eligibility.

opportunities.title: Near West Side BID 10 support
opportunities.audience: Eligible businesses/property owners inside BID 10 boundaries
opportunities.summary: BID 10 lists possible assistance for signage, security cameras, marketing, education/consulting and public art, subject to available funds and board discretion.
opportunities.qualifier: Boundaries and current funding eligibility must be checked for each location; never promise grants.

opportunities.title: Focus on Energy business incentives
opportunities.audience: Qualifying Wisconsin businesses and utility customers
opportunities.summary: Energy advisor services and 2026 rebates for lighting, HVAC and commercial refrigeration/equipment improvements.
opportunities.qualifier: Specific utility, equipment, purchase/installation dates and program limits control qualification; no guaranteed dollar savings.

opportunities.title: Milwaukee County Building Bridges business resources
opportunities.audience: Local businesses opening or expanding brick-and-mortar locations
opportunities.summary: County program offers small-business liaison support, commercial corridor assistance and limited funding possibilities.
opportunities.qualifier: Funding windows, amounts and remaining availability must be reconfirmed directly; don't assume a grant is open.

opportunities.title: Milwaukee Economic Development Corporation
opportunities.audience: Small businesses seeking financing or capital investment
opportunities.summary: Milwaukee's city business toolbox identifies MEDC as a nonprofit offering low-interest loans and business resources.
opportunities.qualifier: Loans are financing, not free grants; underwriting, terms and current availability require direct verification.

opportunities.title: North Avenue Marketplace BID 32
opportunities.audience: Business owners and partners in the BID 32 area
opportunities.summary: North Avenue Marketplace is a city-listed commercial district with an official local program contact.
opportunities.qualifier: Ask BID staff which specific 2026 assistance, partnerships and property boundaries apply; no assumption of funding.
